changelog:
- Initial release of the "trpg-abbr-check-rules" skill.
- Checks and enforces English abbreviation usage in TRPG rules, scenarios, character sheets, catalogs, and maps.
- Replaces in-text English abbreviations of game terms with the format "中文全稱（縮寫）" for all player/GM-facing documents.
- Provides specific rules and exceptions for abbreviation handling, especially in tables and reference files.
- Efficiently processes all relevant files, skipping backups and drafts.
summary: Use this skill when checking and fixing English abbreviations in TRPG rulebooks, scenarios, character sheets, catalogs, maps, and other player/GM-facing file...
